The tenant's period most likely began when the seven-year lease expired in 1992, not in 1986, so my earlier answer was wrong. Withholding rent does not by itself repudiate the owner's title, and a lessee's possession is presumed permissive until the tenant clearly claims ownership against the landlord. On that reading the 20-year period would run to about 2012, so it had not expired when the Boy Scouts discovered their claim in 2009, though the answer depends on the jurisdiction's specific rules.

CONFIDENCE: 55
